name: @pipeworx/mcp-semver

tools.name: parse_semver
tools.description: Parse a semantic-version string into major/minor/patch/prerelease/build (keyless, offline). Accepts an optional leading "v".

tools.name: compare_semver
tools.description: Compare two semver strings. Returns -1 (a<b), 0 (equal), or 1 (a>b), honoring prerelease precedence.

tools.name: satisfies_range
tools.description: Test whether a version satisfies a range: exact, ^ (caret), ~ (tilde), comparators (>=,>,<=,<,=), x-ranges (1.2.x), AND (space-separated), OR (||). E.g. version "1.4.2", range "^1.2.0".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-semver forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the semver pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
